ordinance_area_text: Locust Lane Subdivision and the adjoining R-2 zoning district in Midway Acres Subdivision, more fully described in an exhibit filed with a copy of the ordinance from which this section derives in the office of the county administrator.
method: Rebuilt 2026-11 from Greene County's official WebGIS (Digital Data Technologies ArcGIS MapServer VA/GreeneCo_WebGIS): Parcels layer 2 (PIN, legal description REDES1/2, zoning, plat/deed refs) and Zoning Districts layer 25, queried with f=json, outSR=4326 for the envelope -78.40,38.228,-78.365,38.252. Full-resolution parcel polygons replace the earlier geometry, which had been recovered from the 30%-simplified public layer and cut through several lots. Three named features: (1) Locust Lane Addition lots (PIN blocks 60A-5, 60A-6, 60A-7 incl. residue 60A-7-A, plus 60A-3-13 and 60A-3-14, legal descriptions 'LOCUST LANE ...'); (2) the 'MIDWAY' lots on the same road (60A-2-A..E, 60A-3-4/5/6/11A/15/16/17A, 60A-4-7..10); (3) the R-2 zoning polygon OBJECTID 59 (parcels 60A-12-7, 60A-12-8, 60A-12-8A, in the Midway Acres block 60A-12). Lots were unioned in a local metric plane with a 15 m closing to take in the Locust Lane (Rt 1105) right-of-way, holes under 3000 m2 filled, simplified 1 m, rounded to 1e-5 deg. Script: scratchpad areas-recheck/build.py.
notes: About 0.19 km2 (47 acres) at Midway, US-33 west of Ruckersville (38.24 N, 78.383 W). The ordinance (Ord. of 3-13-90) relies on an exhibit held by the county administrator, which is not online, so this is still a reconstruction. Feature 1 (Locust Lane Addition lots 13-14 and 18-54, 29.4 ac) is the most certain part. Feature 2 (Midway lots 4-11, 15-17 and lettered A-E, 7.8 ac) is on Locust Lane and shares its lot-number sequence, but the tax records call it the 'Midway' subdivision. It may not be part of the 'Locust Lane Subdivision'. It is kept in, with a separate name. Feature 3 is the only R-2 district in Midway Acres today (8.9 ac). It does NOT actually adjoin the Locust Lane lots: it is about 130 m away, with B-1 parcels in between. Today every Locust Lane lot and every Midway Acres tract on New Life Drive is zoned A-1, so the zoning map has clearly changed since 1990. The 1990 'adjoining R-2 district' may instead have been the Midway Acres residential tracts on New Life Drive that border the Locust Lane lots on the east (tax blocks 60A-8 to 60A-11: Spotswood Trail Par 1A/1B-2/2A/2B/3A/3B/C, Tracts A/B1/B2, and Midway Acres Parcels 4-7). Those tracts are NOT mapped. Only the exhibit or the county's 1990 zoning map can settle this. Exception (b)(2): discharge on private property with the owner's or legal possessor's permission is not a violation, provided reasonable care is taken to keep projectiles on the property.
